title: Task Compiler domain-implementation recipes (ADR-0128 §21, WF-0066)
note: Declares the domain-implementation recipe and its four profile recipes as DATA over the existing tc-recipe-runner.mjs DAG shapes (economy/tc-recipe-runner.mjs) — no second compiler is created (ADR-0128 architecture read). Each profile recipe is a linear chain of the §12 playbook steps filtered to that profile (devteam/playbook.mjs stepsForProfile); steps are declarative here (kind='noop' contract markers) — the runtime binds each step to its real action (classify/model/decide/compile/implement/verify/review/receipt). Deterministic and versioned: identical profile input always yields the identical step sequence.

domain-implementation.title: domain-implementation (entry recipe)
domain-implementation.note: Resolves owner -> classifies code intent -> classifies domain applicability -> selects profile -> resolves Decision coverage -> validates domain artifacts -> compiles packet -> injects skills -> dispatches devteam -> scaffolds allowed structures -> implements -> runs domain tests -> runs architecture gates -> reviews -> produces receipt. Dispatches to the matching profile recipe below once the profile is resolved.
